100541.title: Handlebar components and illustrative staging
guidance: Inspect and fit 40 IN of ML Grip Tape (Product Number GT-1209) around the grip areas of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981); the division between sides is assumed.
Fit 2 EA of Mountain End Caps (Product Number EC-M092), one at each end of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981), and check their seating by hand.

Stage 1 EA of Stem (Product Number SM-9087) near the center of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) using an assumed assembly jig. Check the apparent fit without claiming attachment; the interface and hardware are unverified.
